Litigation Risk in Energy Technologies: Evidence from U.S. Patents
abstract: We study patent disputes in the energy sector using litigation data in the U.S. from 2001 to 2016. The estimations of a dynamic fixed-effect Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood innovation model show the characteristics of applicants and patents with an elevated risk of litigation. Specifically, patents frequently cited, those invented by small firms, and patents with a faster review process face a higher risk of litigation. These results provide an overview of patent disputes in the energy sector.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2001年至2016年美国的诉讼数据，研究能源领域的专利纠纷。动态固定效应泊松伪最大似然（PPML）创新模型的估计显示了哪些申请人及专利具有较高的诉讼风险。具体而言，被频繁引用的专利、由小企业发明的专利，以及审查过程较快的专利，面临更高的诉讼风险。这些结果概述了能源领域专利纠纷的情况。

title: Energy Storage and Clean Energy Transitions
Innovation Trends in Electricity Storage: What Drives Global Innovation?
abstract: Using patent data from 1978 to 2019 across 1,881 regions, we estimate the maindeterminants of innovation in energy storage. Our results highlight the role of energyprices and past innovation in shaping innovation. Specifically, a one-unit increase inelectricity prices leads to a 15.54% reduction in the ratio of storage to electricity generationpatents. We also find evidence on the significance of past innovation in shapingthe direction of current innovation. These results imply the need for a combination ofenergy taxes and innovation policies to boost innovation in energy storage.
abstract_zh: 利用1978年至2019年覆盖1,881个地区的专利数据，我们估计了储能领域创新的主要决定因素。我们的结果突出了能源价格和过去的创新在塑造创新中的作用。具体而言，电价每上升一个单位，储能专利与发电专利的比率就会下降15.54%。我们还发现，过去的创新对当前创新方向具有显著影响。这些结果表明，需要将能源税与创新政策相结合，以推动储能领域的创新。

title: From Fossil Fuels to Renewables: The Role of Electricity Storage
Adaptation to Climate Change: How does Heterogeneity in Adaptation Costs Affect Climate Coalitions?
abstract: Adaptation costs to climate change vary widely across countries, especially between developed and developing countries. Adaptation costs also influence a country's decision to abate and join international environmental agreements (IEAs). In this paper, the authors study how these cost differences affect participation incentives. Their model identifies two channels through which adaptation affects free-riding incentives: carbon leakage and cost asymmetry in adaptation. In contrast with the common view, the authors find that the presence of adaptation is not necessarily an impediment to cooperation on abatement. They also present conditions under which adaptation can strengthen or weaken free-riding incentives. The results serve as a cautionary tale to policy makers and suggest that policies directed at reducing carbon leakage and/or cost differences between developed and developing countries may also affect the success and failure of IEAs.
abstract_zh: 各国之间适应气候变化的成本差异很大，发达国家与发展中国家之间尤为明显。适应成本也会影响一国是否选择减排并加入国际环境协议（IEAs）。本文中，作者研究了这些成本差异如何影响参与激励。他们的模型识别出适应影响搭便车激励的两个渠道：碳泄漏以及适应中的成本不对称。与普遍观点相反，作者发现，适应的存在不一定会阻碍减排合作。他们还提出了适应可能增强或削弱搭便车激励的条件。研究结果对政策制定者具有警示意义，并表明，旨在减少碳泄漏和/或发达国家与发展中国家之间成本差异的政策，也可能影响国际环境协议的成败。

title: Can Capital-Energy Substitution Foster Economic Growth?
abstract: We study the ease of substitution between energy and other production inputs over time. We first develop a growth model with energy where our general production function allows for a nonconstant elasticity of substitution. Theoretical results show that the ease of substitution between capital and energy increases over time with the energy-capital ratio. Next, using country-level data from 108 countries between 1971 and 2011, we provide empirical evidence for a nonconstant elasticity of substitution between capital and energy. Our results imply that policies that increase the speed of the capital-energy substitution can foster long-run economic growth. (JEL O11, Q43)
abstract_zh: 我们研究能源与其他生产要素之间的替代难易程度如何随时间变化。我们首先构建了一个包含能源的增长模型，其一般生产函数允许替代弹性非恒定。理论结果表明，资本与能源之间的替代难易程度会随能源—资本比率的上升而提高。接着，利用1971年至2011年间108个国家的国家层面数据，我们为资本与能源之间替代弹性非恒定提供了实证证据。我们的结果表明，能够加快资本—能源替代速度的政策，可以促进长期经济增长。（JEL O11, Q43）

title: Quota Enforcement and Capital Investment in Natural Resource Industries
abstract: We investigate the relationship between quota enforcement, compliance, and Capital accumulation in ITQ regulated fisheries. Over-extraction and over-capacity represent two of the main fisheries management challenges, and we aim to model and analyze the two jointly. In a stylized resource model, quota violating and complying firms invest in capital, buy quotas, and choose their harvest. We show that in the short run, more capacity increases illegal extraction, while a well-functioning quota market partially alleviates this effect. We also show how tougher enforcement yields a double benefit by directly improving compliance, and by indirectly reducing incentives to invest in capacity, which improves future compliance. Our analysis thus contributes to the literature on market-based management of renewable resources.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了ITQ（个别可转让渔获配额）管理的渔业中配额执行、合规性与资本积累之间的关系。过度捕捞与产能过剩是渔业管理的两大主要挑战，我们旨在对二者进行联合建模与分析。在一个简化的资源模型中，违规企业与合规企业投资资本、购买配额并选择捕捞量。我们表明，在短期内，更多的产能会增加非法捕捞，而运行良好的配额市场能在一定程度上缓解这一效应。我们还说明，更严格的执法能带来双重收益：既直接改善合规性，又间接减少投资产能的激励，从而改善未来的合规性。因此，我们的分析丰富了关于可再生资源市场化管理的文献。

title: Past and Future Management of a Collapsed Fishery: The Bay of Biscay Anchovy
abstract: We analyze the efficiency of the international management of the Bay of Biscay anchovy. While a sharing agreement between France and Spain has been in place since 1992, the fish stock collapsed in 2005 and the fishery closed from 2005 to spring 2010. We consider differences in production technologies between both countries and calibrate our model using data from 1987 to 2009. Our results suggest two sources of rent dissipation under the existing sharing agreement: inefficient quota allocation and production inefficiencies due to inflexible national regulations. We discuss several alternatives to improve management.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了比斯开湾鳀鱼国际管理的效率。法国与西班牙自1992年起实行共享协议，但渔业资源于2005年崩溃，该渔业自2005年至2010年春季关闭。我们考虑了两国之间生产技术的差异，并利用1987年至2009年的数据对模型进行了校准。我们的结果表明，现行共享协议下存在两个导致租金耗散的来源：配额分配效率低下，以及因国家法规僵化而造成的生产低效。我们讨论了改善管理的若干替代方案。
